items.title: Summary of New Testament Teaching on Christian Sacrifice
items.why: This source provides a scholarly examination of the concept of sacrifice in the New Testament, which aligns with the claim regarding Jesus as the fulfillment of Old Testament themes related to sacrifice. It likely addresses the broader theological implications of Jesus' sacrificial role, which connects to new birth and the new covenant themes.
